question: Choose the right combination of the famous celebrity and their respective outfit.

options.text: Poona Public Meeting - Subhash Chandra Bose

solution:
The correct answer is __**Satyashodhak Samaj - Jyotiba Phule**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Satyashodhak Samaj__

 __
 
• Satyasodhak Samaj was founded with a purpose to give education to the lower castes, scheduled castes, scheduled tribes and make them aware of the exploiting tradition of the society.
 
• It was founded by Jyotitrao Phule in 1873 in Pune.
 
• Satyashodhak Samaj rejected all kinds of Brahman domination and exploitation based on religion and all religious sources of inequality.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ​Jyotirao Phule__

 
 
• ​He was an Indian social activist, thinker, anti-caste social reformer, and writer from Maharashtra.
 
• His work extended to many fields, including eradicating untouchability, and the caste system, and his efforts to educate women and people of exploited castes.
